text: 到目前为止，觅食所得还足以养活你们三人；但要徒步穿越一百多英里的原始荒野，绝非易事。北汉尼纳河岸有时沼泽遍布，有时陡峭得无法沿岸通行。你们必须穿越峡谷和密林，同时不能迷失方向。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 54
text: The forage so far has been adequate to sustain the three of you, but it is no small undertaking to march over more than a hundred miles of virgin wilderness. Sometimes, the banks of the North Hanninah are too swampy or too sheer to follow. Your party must cross canyons and deep woods without losing its bearing.
